retroboeken_route: WVO record HTML for a solved sibling links directly to the retroboeken viewer with a page number (e.g. 5109's page linked '#page=261...' -- an internal viewer index, not the printed page number). The viewer is a Dojo single-page app with no static image URL in the HTML; its book_data.js gives base_url and accessor ids, and the per-page image/html URLs come from '<base_url>/pages.json?source=1', each entry {page_index, source, number, image_url, html_url}. 'number' is the sequential asset number (not always equal to the printed page number, though it happened to run 31 less than page_index in this range); image_url points to a static .jpg under /retroapp/service_willemdeeerste/willemdeeerste/images/, no auth needed.
